# spikes: `SpikesReport`

The `data` payload of `openreadout analyze spikes FILE --trace N --json`, inside the [envelope](envelope.md).

Output of `analyze spikes`.

JSON Schema: [`docs/schema/spikes.schema.json`](https://github.com/openreadout/openreadout/blob/main/docs/schema/spikes.schema.json) · also printed by `openreadout self schema spikes`.

| field | type | always present | description |

| `path` | `string` | yes | Input path. |
| `format` | `string` | yes | Format id. |
| `trace` | `integer` (uint32) | yes | Trace analysed. |
| `sample_rate_hz` | `number` (double) | yes | Sampling rate, Hz. |

## Types

### DetectSettings

Detection settings.

| field | type | always present | description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `low_hz` | `number` (double) | yes | Band-pass low edge, Hz. |
| `high_hz` | `number` (double) | yes | Band-pass high edge, Hz (clamped to 0.45 × the sampling rate). |
| `order` | `integer` (uint) | yes | Butterworth order. |
| `threshold` | `number` (double) | yes | Threshold in noise units. |
| `sign` | [`PeakSign`](#peaksign) | yes | Direction. |
| `exclude_ms` | `number` (double) | yes | Exclusion half-window, ms. |

### PeakSign

Which deflections count.

| value | meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `"neg"` | Negative-going (the usual extracellular spike). |
| `"pos"` | Positive-going. |
| `"both"` | Either. |

### ChannelSpikes

Detection results of one channel.

| field | type | always present | description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `channel` | `integer` (uint32) | yes | Channel index. |
| `name` | `string` | yes | Channel name. |
| `unit` | `string` or `null` |  | Unit of `noise` and `threshold`. |
| `noise` | `number` (double) | yes | Noise (MAD / 0.6745 of the filtered signal; the first sweep analysed). |
| `threshold` | `number` (double) | yes | Detection threshold (`threshold × noise`). |

| `rate_hz` | `number` (double) | yes | Spikes per second of analysed signal. |
| `duration_s` | `number` (double) | yes | Seconds analysed. |
| `times` | array of [`SpikeTime`](#spiketime) | yes | Spike times, s from each sweep's start, with the sweep (at most `max_times`). |
| `times_truncated` | `boolean` | yes | True when `times` was cut. |
